content: {"rule": "K-S2", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text declares UNDERDETERMINED by treating Matthew 1:16's admitted double reading as the reason.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "D1 vs C2 (Matthew 1:16): UNDERDETERMINED -- the passive egennēthē (was born) with feminine hēs (of whom) admits both the withheld-father and the birth-narration readings; the defender answered the beget-pattern and naming witnesses in [CR3] LINK 4 and [CR2] §5, and the challenger answered hēs in [DR3] C2.", "rule_words": "That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
